items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Who's that? Buddy P. What did he play? Trumpet. Yeah. Nice trumpet player. Buddy never did. Did really ever make a record?

ctx.x: Jimmy Johnson. What did he look like? What did he look like Jimmy? Well he was a dark slender fellow.

My boy, I can't help say about him for some reason cause he didn't ever do, he was a hell of a man but never made a record. Who's that? Buddy P. What did he play? Trumpet. Yeah. Nice trumpet player. Buddy never did. Did really ever make a record?
